extName.message: MagicProxy — per-profile proxy for your own server

extDescription.message: Route one browser profile through your own proxy server. Other profiles and the rest of your system stay direct.

warnWebrtcForeign.message: WebRTC: another extension controls the policy — your real IP may be visible to sites

tunHint.message: MagicProxy: active TUN adapter detected ($ADAPTERS$). Another proxy client is capturing all system traffic, including our connection to your server — double proxying breaks the handshake. Switch that client to plain proxy mode or add your server's address to its bypass list.

errProxyForeign.message: the proxy is controlled by another extension — disable it and try again

errProxyBlocked.message: the browser does not allow controlling proxy settings in this profile

statusOffForeign.message: Off. Another extension holds this profile's proxy

bannerCoreBroken.message: The networking core won't start — open the guide

bannerHostMissing.message: Background component not installed — install it

errCoreMissing.message: Networking core not found — an antivirus may have removed it

errHostForbidden.message: Background component refuses connections from this extension

errSshHostKey.message: SSH: hostKey is not set. Run “ssh-keyscan -t ed25519 <server>” and paste the “ssh-ed25519 AAAA…” line into the profile's hostKey field

importHint.message: Paste one or more links (vless://, vmess://, trojan://, ss://, hysteria2://, tuic://) — one per line — or a base64 subscription.

importSubscriptionUrl.message: This is a subscription link. Fetching subscriptions by URL is not supported yet — open it in the browser and paste its contents here.

exportEmpty.message: Nothing to export — there are no profiles.

exportDone.message: Saved $N$ profile(s). The file contains passwords and keys — treat it like a password.

confirmDelete.message: Delete profile $NAME$? Its connection credentials will be lost.

proxyDomainsLabel.message: Proxy only these domains (one per line; empty = everything except the direct list):

routingSaved.message: Saved ✓ — while the proxy is on, the rules apply within half a minute

updatesHint.message: The sing-box core handles every protocol. Keep it fresh.

updRunning.message: Downloading and updating (the proxy will be off for a moment)…

dataStored.message: Stored in this browser profile. Server profiles with their connection credentials — UUIDs, passwords, keys — routing rules and the on/off state. Everything lives in the extension's local storage, is not synced and is never sent anywhere: the project has no servers.

dataPassed.message: Passed to the background component on your own computer: start and stop commands, the selected server's configuration and status replies. Browsing history, page addresses and page contents are never passed to it.

dataNever.message: Not collected at all: no accounts, no telemetry, no analytics. The extension requests no access to websites and injects nothing into pages.

obStep1.message: Pin the 🪄 icon to the toolbar. Click the puzzle piece 🧩 to the right of the address bar and hit the pin next to MagicProxy. Otherwise the on/off indicator stays hidden.

obStep2.message: Add your server. Paste a link — vless://, vmess://, trojan://, ss://, hysteria2://, tuic://, anytls://, ssh://, socks5://, http(s):// and base64 subscriptions are supported.

obNoLinkSummary.message: I don't have a link yet

obNoLinkBody.message: MagicProxy does not provide servers — it connects to yours. People usually get a link one of two ways: they set up a server on their own VPS (Xray and sing-box have one-command install scripts) or buy one from a provider. The link format is the same either way — just paste it here.

obMissingBody1.message: A sandboxed browser extension cannot carry VLESS traffic by itself — a small background component does that. It needs to be installed once.

obMissingBody2.message: The installer has everything inside: the component and the networking core. No internet is needed to install, nothing else to download.

mirrorsLabel.message: If the link does not open, try a mirror:

obSmartScreen.message: Windows will show a blue “Windows protected your PC” box — the usual warning for programs without a paid signature. Click “More info” → “Run anyway”. The file's checksum can be verified on the release page.

obAutoNotice.message: Run the installer — this page will notice by itself.

obCoreTitle.message: The background component is there, but the networking core won't start

obCoreBody1.message: Most often it is an antivirus: proxy tools trip its heuristics and sing-box.exe goes to quarantine. The file is installed — nothing needs to be downloaded.

obCoreBody2.message: Check the antivirus quarantine and add the MagicProxy folder to its exclusions, then press “Check again”. If that does not help — reinstall.

obSubscriptionLink.message: That looks like a subscription link, not a server link. Open the settings — subscription import lives there.

obAddedTail.message: . Open 🪄 on the toolbar and press “Turn on”.
